title: Amendments
key_points: The Ripple consensus ledger is updated through amendments.
There are three types of amendments: Amendments, Validation Rules, and Reserved Bits.
Each amendment has a unique identifier called the 'amendment ID'.
Amendments specify changes to the validation rules and protocol behavior.
Clients should upgrade to stay compatible with the latest amendments.
limitations: The scope is limited to the Ripple consensus ledger and its updates through amendments.
It does not cover client implementations or specific use cases.
asserts: Amendments are an integral part of the Ripple consensus ledger update process, specifying changes to validation rules and protocol behavior.
scope: The context is the Ripple consensus ledger and its amendment process, covering the specification of changes to validation rules and protocol behavior.
